drawPool.membership: present on at least one LOCKED_ACTIVE board
drawPool.selection: guided random (D-33) over the remaining pool using cryptographically secure integers: no winner before draw winFrom unless no safe skill exists, at most maxWinners co-winners unless forced, a win pushed with rising probability from draw pushFrom and forced from draw winTo when one is available; config drawGuidance=false (BINGO_DRAW_GUIDANCE=off) gives uniform random

evaluation.coWinners: All LOCKED_ACTIVE boards with at least one complete line after the accepted draw N (N >= 4) are winners of draw N. The winning draw closes drawing atomically.
evaluation.atomicity: draw selection, persistence, match computation, evaluation of all active boards, winner persistence, version increment, and outbox events occur in one durable transaction.
